statements.markdown:
For many spins, we seek the limiting expected
maximum **per spin**,

$$
P_*:=\lim_{n\to\infty}\frac1n\mathbb E\max_\sigma H_n(\sigma),
$$

where expectation averages over the couplings after taking the maximum.
The cited theorem is stated for the almost-sure normalized maximum. Its expected-value formulation used here follows from Gaussian concentration.
statements.note: Not in the Lean: it defines the value through expectations and proves the limit by subadditivity, with no almost-sure theorem and no concentration step.
